title: Configuration kit: .env, deep merge and validation
statement:
# Configuration kit (`src/`)

Package with three independent modules — `env.mjs` (`.env` parser), `merge.mjs` (deep merge) and `validate.mjs` (schema validation) — and an `index.mjs` that combines them in `loadConfig`. Reports: database URLs with a query string do not load from the `.env`, and values at the minimum allowed limit are rejected. All modules must fully obey the contract below.

## `src/env.mjs`

`parseEnv(text)` → object `{ KEY: 'value' }` (all values are strings).
- Lines separated by `\n` or `\r\n`. Each line is trimmed; empty lines and lines starting with `#` are ignored. Optional `export ` prefix.
- The key is the part before the **first** `=` (trimmed) and must match `/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/`; the value is everything after that `=` (trimmed) and may contain other `=`. E.g.: `'URL=pg://h/db?a=1&b=2'` → `{ URL: 'pg://h/db?a=1&b=2' }`; `'K==v'` → `{ K: '=v' }`; `'EMPTY='` → `{ EMPTY: '' }`.
- Double-quoted value: the quotes are removed and the escapes `\n`, `\t`, `\"`, `\\` are interpreted (`A="a\nb"` → `'a' + line break + 'b'`); `#` inside the quotes is text. Single-quoted value: literal, without escapes. Unclosed quotes → `SyntaxError`.
- Unquoted value: a `#` preceded by whitespace starts a comment (discarded, along with the whitespace). `'A=abc # x'` → `'abc'`; `'B=a#b'` → `'a#b'`.
- Repeated key: the last one wins.
- Line without `=` or with an invalid key → `SyntaxError` whose message contains `line N` (N starts at 1, counting all lines of the text).

## `src/merge.mjs`

- `deepMerge(base, override)` → **new** object. For each key of `override`: if the value is `undefined`, the key is ignored; if the value and the corresponding base value are both plain objects, they are merged recursively; in any other case the override value replaces it (including `null`, `0`, `false`, `''`; arrays replace, they do not concatenate). E.g.: `deepMerge({ a: 1, b: 2 }, { a: undefined, b: null })` → `{ a: 1, b: null }`; `deepMerge({ debug: true }, { debug: false })` → `{ debug: false }`.
- No input is changed and the result shares no objects nor arrays with the inputs (changing the result does not affect `base`/`override`).
- `mergeAll(...layers)`: applies `deepMerge` from left to right starting from `{}`, ignoring `null`/`undefined` layers. `mergeAll()` → `{}`.
- `isPlainObject(v)`: `true` for objects whose prototype is `Object.prototype` or `null`.

## `src/validate.mjs`

`validate(input, schema)` → `{ ok, value, errors }`. Schema: `{ [key]: { type: 'string'|'number'|'integer'|'boolean', required?, default?, min?, max?, oneOf? } }`.
- For each key of the schema, in schema order:
  - `undefined` value: if there is a `default`, `value[key] = default` (without validating); otherwise, if `required`, error `"<key>: required"`; otherwise the key is left out of `value`.
  - string conversion: for `number`/`integer`, a non-empty string (after trim) whose `Number(s)` is finite becomes a number; for `boolean`, `'true'`/`'1'` → `true` and `'false'`/`'0'` → `false`. Other strings stay as they are.
  - checks, in order, recording **only the first** error of the key: type (`"<key>: expected <type>"`; `integer` requires an integer number, `number` requires a finite number); `min` (`"<key>: must be >= <min>"`); `max` (`"<key>: must be <= <max>"`); `oneOf` (`"<key>: must be one of a, b"` — items joined by `', '`). `min` and `max` are **inclusive**: with `min: 1, max: 10`, the values 1 and 10 are valid.
  - a valid value (already converted) goes to `value[key]`.
- Afterwards, each key of `input` that is not in the schema generates `"<key>: unknown key"`, in `input` order.
- `ok` = there are no errors. E.g.: `validate({}, { port: { type: 'integer', default: 3000 }, host: { type: 'string', required: true } })` → `{ ok: false, value: { port: 3000 }, errors: ['host: required'] }`.

## `src/index.mjs`

`loadConfig({ defaults, envText, overrides, schema })`: `mergeAll(defaults, .env keys present in the schema, overrides)` and then `validate`; throws `Error` listing the errors if invalid; returns `value`.

bugs.summary: key/value separated by the LAST '=' (lastIndexOf) instead of the first
deepMerge skips any falsy override value (if (!v)) instead of only undefined: null/0/false/'' do not replace
min treated as exclusive (v <= min produces an error)
